t.zh: 把一个像素和它的邻居平均，图就模糊了。均值滤波每个邻居一样重；高斯滤波让中心最重、越远越轻，模糊得更柔和、更自然。
t.en: Averaging a pixel with its neighbours blurs the picture. A mean filter weighs every neighbour equally; a Gaussian weighs the centre most and the farther ones less, a softer, more natural blur.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个亮点经过高斯模糊，会变成什么样？先手算，再用二维滤波器接一个高斯模糊器：行和列的权重都是 1/4、1/2、1/4。
t.en: This level asks: what does a single bright point become after a Gaussian blur? Work it out by hand, then wire a Gaussian blur from the 2D filter, the row and column weights both 1/4, 1/2, 1/4.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 横竖各滤一遍的模糊图，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image; gives it blurred by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] across and down, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>：一个亮点变成中间亮、四周渐暗的一团。核越大、σ 越大，模糊越强。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>: a bright point becomes a blob, bright in the middle and fading out. The larger the kernel and σ, the stronger the blur.

brief.zh: 这张图只有 (1, 1) 是 16：横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤一遍，图外补 0，写出结果。
brief.en: Only (1, 1) of this image is 16: filter across and down with [1/4, 1/2, 1/4], 0 outside, and write the result.

hint.zh: 先横着滤：16 分到左、中、右三格各是多少？
hint.en: Filter across first: how much of the 16 goes to the left, centre and right?

why.zh: 这是只横着滤了一遍：竖直方向也要滤，亮点向上下扩散，中心只剩 4。
why.en: That filters across only: down must be filtered too, spreading the point up and down and leaving 4 at the centre.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
brief.en: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

solution: f = filter2D(image, q, h, q, q, h, q)
naive: f = filter2D(image, t, t, t, z, o, z)
